method: pipeline/patches/2022_MI_HOUSE_midland.py sums the Representative in Congress (office code 6) rows for MIDLAND across both districts touching the county (2nd and 8th). MIT had only the 2nd District part (1,211 D / 2,993 R, which matches the official 2nd District figure exactly).
validation: Midland County (26111) official: CD2 Hilliard (D) 1,211, Moolenaar (R) 2,993, Hewer (L) 82; CD8 Kildee (D) 16,621, Junge (R) 18,305, Canny (L) 588, Goodwin (WC) 881; total dem 17,832 / rep 21,298 / oth 1,551. State after filling: dem 2,184,702 / rep 2,083,400 vs official statewide 2,184,504 / 2,083,361: +0.01% / +0.00%.
